#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
if [[ "${AIFILM_CLEAN_REEXEC:-}" != 1 ]]; then
  exec env -i HOME=/home/dragon USER=dragon LOGNAME=dragon LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 \
    PATH=/usr/bin:/bin AIFILM_CLEAN_REEXEC=1 "$0" "$@"
fi
umask 077
BASE=/home/dragon/ai-film-runtime
RELEASE="${1:?release name required}"
[[ "$RELEASE" =~ ^dev[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo INVALID_RELEASE >&2; exit 2; }
TARGET="$BASE/$RELEASE"
[[ -d "$TARGET/app" && -x "$TARGET/bin/verify-runtime" && -f "$TARGET/runtime-manifest.json" ]] || { echo INCOMPLETE_RELEASE >&2; exit 3; }
"$TARGET/bin/verify-runtime" >/dev/null
OLD=$(readlink -f "$BASE/current" 2>/dev/null || true)
NEXT="$BASE/.current.next.$$"
ln -s "$TARGET" "$NEXT"
mv -Tf "$NEXT" "$BASE/current"
HASH=$(sha256sum "$TARGET/runtime-manifest.json" | awk '{print $1}')
printf '%s old=%s new=%s manifest=%s runtime_only=true\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "${OLD:-NONE}" "$TARGET" "$HASH" >> "$BASE/release-history.log"
chmod 600 "$BASE/release-history.log"
echo "RUNTIME_ACTIVATION_PASS $RELEASE NATIVE_SITE_AUTHORITY_UNCHANGED"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
if [[ "${AIFILM_CLEAN_REEXEC:-}" != 1 ]]; then
  exec env -i HOME=/home/dragon USER=dragon LOGNAME=dragon LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 \
    PATH=/usr/bin:/bin AIFILM_CLEAN_REEXEC=1 "$0" "$@"
fi
exec /home/dragon/ai-film-runtime/current/bin/verify-runtime

[Unit]
Description=AI-FILM Phase00 current runtime integrity verification
After=default.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/home/dragon/ai-film-runtime/current
ExecStart=/home/dragon/ai-film-runtime/current/bin/verify-runtime
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
PrivateDevices=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=read-only
ReadWritePaths=/home/dragon/ai-film-runtime/current/var/tmp
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectKernelModules=true
ProtectKernelLogs=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
ProtectClock=true
ProtectHostname=true
RestrictRealtime=true
RestrictSUIDSGID=true
LockPersonality=true
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=true
SystemCallArchitectures=native
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
